painpoints.text: Planner prompt mandates a fabro_runs_list in-flight PR check (fabro-06e0), but this stage's toolset exposes no such tool — the check degraded to a no-op. Fix: either expose fabro_runs_list to the planner stage or make the prompt state the degraded fallback explicitly when the tool is absent (run 01M2183254XQ3HJ45SR4P1Y2X6).

observations: Claimed fabro-85a1 (top High bug, no blockers). Basis resolved: merge-upstream workflow.toml lacks [run.clone] while conductor has depth=0 (commit a4850e681 pattern to mirror). In-flight PR check could not run (tool unavailable); no exclusions applied.

Cold `cargo run -p fabro-cli -- validate` from a clean target dir took ~7 min build; building once with `cargo build -q -p fabro-cli` then reusing `target/debug/fabro` is the cheaper path for config-only smoke checks (target/ is gitignored, no artifact-hygiene impact).
